new_value: Fixed by the 2vp1 change: all COSE envelope+payload dataclasses are now frozen (post-construction mutation impossible) and __post_init__ enforces payload_bytes-decodes-to-payload equality (re-run by dataclasses.replace). The unprotected kid fields (delegator_iid/old_iid/root_iid/announcer_iid) can no longer diverge from the retained signed payload, so to_cose_sign1 can no longer emit a self-inconsistent blob.
